text:
Turn them over,
seize them by the tail (let them squeal, whores),
whip them,
give sugar to the balky ones’ mouths,
blow them up, balloons, prick them,
suck out their blood and marrow,
dry them,
geld them,
trample them, gallant rooster,
wring their necks, cook,
pluck them,
gut them, bull,
ox, drag them,
make them, poet,
make them swallow all their words.

translation.title: Words
translation.editorial_note: The poem’s brutal imperative register and shifting animal metaphors are not softened; rejegas becomes balky ones, retaining the resistant mares within the feminized words.
